run_get_ranks_cli: run the get_ranks script with a trajectory directory path to compute model rankings and save CSV results
calculate_rankings: calculate model rankings from a scores dictionary sorted by maximize or minimize metric direction
compute_plackett_luce_ranking: compute a Plackett-Luce aggregate ranking from a dictionary of per-task model rankings
compute_broda_ranking: compute a Borda count aggregate ranking from a dictionary of per-task model rankings
calculate_performance_ratios: calculate performance ratios for each model relative to the best score for a given task
